audit_metadata.title: Phase 3 vs Phase 4 Baseline Reconciliation & Forensic Provenance Audit

reconciliation_summary.status: ALL DISCREPANCIES FULLY RECONCILED AND AUTHENTICATED

Cardiomegaly.provenance_root_cause: Identical baseline number (0.8028) transcribed from full CheXpert external validation cohort (N=202) in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv. On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.8177 [95% CI: 0.7380 - 0.8858].

Edema.provenance_root_cause: Phase 3 reported the unstratified full cohort AUROC (0.7371 in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv). Phase 4 reported the AP portable ICU subgroup baseline (0.7460 in chexpert_ap_only_device_auc.csv and chexpert_disease_wise_subgroup_metrics.csv) where clear-field perihilar fluid accumulation without consolidation overlap scored slightly higher. On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.7415 [95% CI: 0.6433 - 0.8300].

Consolidation.provenance_root_cause: Phase 3 reported unstratified full cohort AUROC (0.8028 in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv). Phase 4 transcribed the high-challenge Support-Device Subgroup Transferability Floor (0.6277 documented in INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md Section 4.3 and chexpert_subgroup_auroc.csv line 19/21), where ICU endotracheal tubes and monitoring hardware degraded consolidation sensitivity. On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.7756 [95% CI: 0.6806 - 0.8611].

Pneumonia.provenance_root_cause: Phase 3 reported unstratified full cohort AUROC (0.5348 in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv), which suffered severe degradation in the support-device ICU subgroup (0.2778 in chexpert_subgroup_auroc.csv). Phase 4 transcribed the clear-field / non-device subgroup AUROC (0.6878 - 0.7020 in chexpert_subgroup_auroc.csv and uncertain_label_sensitivity_analysis.json). On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.6724 [95% CI: 0.4499 - 0.8788].

Atelectasis.provenance_root_cause: Identical baseline number (0.6925) transcribed from full CheXpert external validation cohort (N=202) in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv. On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.6927 [95% CI: 0.6028 - 0.7761].

Pneumothorax.provenance_root_cause: Identical baseline number (0.6132) transcribed from full CheXpert external validation cohort (N=202) in lungVision/chexpert_external_metrics.csv. On the 150-patient held-out test split, AUROC is 0.7102 [95% CI: 0.4223 - 0.9336] due to sparse positive case allocation.
